title: Dev Server Target
description: Dev Server target options for Build Facade.

buildTarget.description: A target using @loozo/angular-router:application, as project:target[:configuration]. Router options come from it.

proxyConfig.description: Proxy configuration file. For more information, see https://angular.dev/tools/cli/serve#proxying-to-a-backend-server.

sslKey.description: SSL key to use for serving HTTPS.

sslCert.description: SSL certificate to use for serving HTTPS.

allowedHosts.description: The hosts that the development server will respond to. This option sets the Vite option of the same name. For further details: https://vite.dev/config/server-options.html#server-allowedhosts

oneOf.description: A list of hosts that the development server will respond to.
Indicates that all hosts are allowed. This is not recommended and a security risk.

define.description: Defines global identifiers that will be replaced with a specified constant value when found in any JavaScript or TypeScript code including libraries. The value will be used directly. String values must be put in quotes. Identifiers within Angular metadata such as Component Decorators will not be replaced.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to be added to all responses.

open.description: Opens the url in default browser.

verbose.description: Adds more details to output logging.

liveReload.description: Whether to reload the page on change, using live-reload.

servePath.description: The pathname where the application will be served.

hmr.description: Enable hot module replacement. Defaults to the value of 'liveReload'. Currently, only global and component stylesheets are supported.

poll.description: Watch by polling every this many milliseconds. Defaults to 1000 when omitted. false adds no default, so Angular's own configuration applies, including a poll on the build target.

inspect.description: Activate debugging inspector. This option only has an effect when 'SSR' or 'SSG' are enabled.

oneOf.description: Activate the inspector on host and port in the format of `[[host:]port]`. See the security warning in https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v22.x/api/cli.html#warning-binding-inspector-to-a-public-ipport-combination-is-insecure regarding the host parameter usage.

prebundle.description: Enable and control the Vite-based development server's prebundling capabilities. To enable prebundling, the Angular CLI cache must also be enabled.

exclude.description: List of package imports that should not be prebundled by the development server. The packages will be bundled into the application code itself. Note: specifying `@foo/bar` marks all paths within the `@foo/bar` package as excluded, including sub-paths like `@foo/bar/baz`.
